target_customer: Mobile app developers whose iOS and Android apps need faster, cheaper networking to their backends
problem: Mobile apps suffer slow and unreliable connections to their backends, which standard CDNs do little to fix.
business_model: Developer infrastructure: client library plus a paid proxy network (mobile CDN)

founders.name: Brien Colwell
founders.background_notes: YC page says earlier career as a startup engineer and HCI researcher, and later co-founder and CTO of HeadSpin (2015 to 2022). Employers and education before Nextop not stated.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists it as inactive and the founder moved on to HeadSpin. No post-mortem or acquisition found.

competitors.name: Twin Prime
competitors.what: Last mile mobile app acceleration SDK that complements CDNs
competitors.traction_then: Came out of stealth in March 2015

technical_complexity.rationale: A custom network protocol, client libraries for two operating systems and a global proxy network, built by a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: The protocol and proxy network were technical but copyable by well funded rivals, and developers could swap an SDK.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large CDNs later moved into mobile acceleration. Cloudflare bought Neumob, a similar mobile SDK company, with the service later folded in. No acquisition of Nextop found.

market_need_then: Industry commentary in this period said standard CDNs did little for mobile apps, and several funded startups (Twin Prime, PacketZoom, Neumob) targeted the same gap.

branding.domain_note: nextop.io, per the YC page. A Polish company named Nextop shares the name.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, no community and no identity assets were found.

outcome_analysis: Nextop was a two person mobile CDN started in 2014 and part of YC Winter 2015. No funding, customers or shutdown cause are public, and the founder later co-founded HeadSpin. The cause is not public, so failure factors stay empty. Funded rivals such as Twin Prime and later Neumob and PacketZoom pursued the same wedge.
